integrity: Proof uses the explicit integer companion-matrix power and a binomial valuation estimate. Verification software is finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Classical Perrin recurrence and prime 3 only; two 3-adic roots given by exact lifting, not elementary closed forms. Bibliographic completeness and independent validation are not asserted.
title: Exact ternary valuations and uniformly bounded discrepancy for Perrin numbers
